must_haves: security and where data is stored (Stockholm)

layout.idea: Filled magazine grid: an asymmetric 6-column grid where every tile carries a real asset (screenshot crop, 3D object, real quote, diagram) with a caption; no empty tiles.
layout.why: Gives the coming assets a gallery without the empty bento look.

hero.idea: Dashboard hero: a tight crop of the real dashboard with connected inboxes and recent actions, plus a 'see the draft card' secondary link.
hero.why: Shows there is a real product and control panel behind the connector.

visual_style.idea: Marker highlight: plain black-and-white body with key phrases (never stored, you approve) highlighted in a light cobalt-soft wash, like a highlighter.
visual_style.why: Draws the eye to the two promises that matter.

typography.idea: Atkinson Hyperlegible 400/700 for headings and body, DM Mono 400 for addresses.
typography.why: Legibility as a value, good for an audience that reads carefully.

narrative.idea: Provider-first: 'Which inbox do you use?' picker at the top; the steps and notes below adapt to the chosen provider.
narrative.why: Every visitor reads their own setup story.

proof.idea: Listings in public MCP directories, linked out to the actual listing pages.
proof.why: Third-party presence that visitors can verify.

asset_use.idea: Detail crops at 200%: the Approve button, the To field, the inbox picker, each with a numbered callout and short label.
asset_use.why: Points at the exact controls that matter.

motion.idea: Each section fades up 8px once on entry (200ms), disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

section_order.idea: Hero question > Answer card > How it got there (diagram) > What it can do > What it won't do > Pricing > Start free

voice.idea: Postal and playful. Sample: 'We carry the letter. We don't keep a copy.'
voice.why: A memorable metaphor that is also the privacy promise.

wildcard.idea: The page is a manual's table of contents; every line expands into its section in place.
wildcard.why: One screen holds the whole product.
